extendedProps.description:
Buffalo Comedy Collective's Open Mic night! Hosted by Sherman & Mingo of A Murder of Crows podcast, our stand-up open mics are every second Friday starting at 9:00 PM.

Those interested in performing five (5) minute sets are welcome to put their names on our virtual sign-up sheet for a chance to hit the stage. To submit your name, please fill out the registration form. We will reach out within one (1) week of the event to let individuals know if they are performing. Performers may sign up upon arrival as well, but there is no guarantee of performance & cover fee still applies to those not signed up in advance.

Time - 9:00 PM (Doors Open at 8:45 PM, Bar & Dining Open at 6:00 PM)

Ticket Pricing - $5.00 (Performers Registered in Advance - Free)
extendedProps.location: 155 Chandler St, Buffalo, NY 14207, USA

extendedProps.description:
Helium holds its Open Mic Night on SELECT Wednesday nights at 7:30PM

Sign Up

So you think you have what it takes to make people laugh? Helium holds its Open Mic Night on SELECT Wednesday nights at 7:30PM, open to both new talent and seasoned comics. Comics signing up should prepare at least 3 minutes of material.

Before your desired performance date, please check the lineup below to see if you made the cut. If you did not make the online list, there is another opportunity to sign up in-person the night of the event. To sign up in-person, arrive by 6PM the night of the show. The earlier you arrive to sign up, the better. If you are on the list below, please arrive and check in with the bar. The list will be printed at 6:30 and comics who have not checked in will lose their time on stage. This will also effect future Open Mic selection if you do not show up.

Please note that you will not be able to sign up in person later than 6:30PM. Take advantage of this opportunity before the show to network with other comedians and enjoy our happy hour specials.
extendedProps.location: 30 Mississippi St, Buffalo, NY 14203
